# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _contact_row(student: Student) -> str:
    if not student.email:
        raise ProjectError(f"no email for {student.display_name}")
    name = student.display_name
    return f"{name:<20} {student.section:<8} {student.email}"


# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by display name."""
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    if not ordered:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    return [_contact_row(student) for student in ordered]
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            Student("2", "Young", "Zed", "B", "zed@example.org"),
            Student("1", "Adams", "Amy", "A", "amy@example.org")
        ])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Adams, Amy"))
        self.assertEqual(rows[0].index("A  "), rows[1].index("B  "))
        self.assertTrue(rows[1].endswith("zed@example.org"))

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ProjectError, "Adams, Amy"):
            contact_rows([Student("1", "Adams", "Amy", "A")])

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
